scalars.scalar_value: Previous experience in a large complex healthcare environment.
Previous leadership experience in a directly related laboratory position.
Days, 8-Hour Shifts, Monday-Friday, some weekends and holidays

items.item_text: BART or BLS at time of hire with commitment to get BART within 6 months of hire date.
Must be able to work various hours and locations based on business needs.

Employment is subject to a criminal background check and a pre-employment physical.• Complies with all policies and standards.• Complies with the University of California, San Diego Health (UCSDH) Principles of Community.
A minimum of a two-year degree in a related field or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Bachelor's degree with emphasis in science background.
Previous leadership experience in a directly related laboratory position.
Previous experience in a large complex healthcare environment.

Under direction, the technician is responsible for pre- and post- analytical activities. This includes both direct supervision of staff and problem solving related to laboratory testing operations. Responsibility to review, clarify and organize all lab requests, use laboratory information systems to receive, accession, process, distribute specimens and bill samples and tests to in-house and/or reference laboratories as appropriate. Independently check all requisitions to ensure completeness of order and follows up with CLS staff if problems are discovered. Provide customer support by correctly and quickly responding to telephone calls for information related to pre-analytical activities and analytical methodologies, and post analytical methodologies, and post analytical results reporting.
